title: API 2 Task 16/16 — Final Mobile + System Certification
scope: Verification-only final certification for NFL Game Totals V10 mobile/responsive usability, frozen system integrity, and Runless proof closeout.
candidate_head_policy: The exact branch head after this ledger commit is the authoritative Task-16 candidate; PR and Runless proof must use that exact SHA.

responsive_browser.source: actual frozen V9/V10 functions and CSS executed from source AST; no product mutation

rulings.finding: The execution sandbox blocks Chromium navigation to localhost and does not provide the Streamlit Python package, so a fresh hosted/local Streamlit session could not be driven from this environment.
rulings.decision: Use real Chromium responsive rendering of the actual frozen V9/V10 HTML/CSS for viewport proof, combined with the existing dedicated V8.1 functional mobile contract for next-game recovery, fail-closed provider behavior, full-width controls, targeted cache clearing, and projection-firewall behavior.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: A Streamlit-runtime-only responsive integration defect could remain undetected; therefore this evidence must not be described as a fresh hosted-production Streamlit browser session. Exact frozen runtime hashes and Runless proof remain mandatory before freeze.

rulings.finding: The local pytest executable did not place the snapshot root on sys.path and initially could not import the devsystem namespace.
rulings.decision: Run the unchanged tests with PYTHONPATH=. in the snapshot harness.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: None to product behavior; only the local certification harness import path is affected.
